text: Altibox, the Norwegian fibre broadband brand, has since April 2024 been a brand within Lyse Tele AS, a subsidiary of the Lyse group; until then Altibox AS was a wholly owned Lyse subsidiary.
short: Altibox is a brand within Lyse Tele AS.
